output.summary: A genus of annuals, shrubs and subshrubs native to scrub and dry grassland from the southwestern United States to South America, with greatest diversity in Mexico. Their long-stemmed flower heads range from single rows to domed forms and occur in many bright colours. Some zinnias are edible, though often bitter and mainly suited to garnish.
output.edibilityNote: Some zinnias are edible but often bitter and best suited to garnish.
